task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Place the small soda can with lime graphics into the durable plasticbox with side handle, then lift the red can with smooth metallic texture and set it into the durable plasticbox with side handle.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架将带有石灰图形的小汽水罐放入带侧手柄的耐用塑料盒中，然后抬起具有光滑金属质感的红色罐并将其放入带侧手柄的耐用塑料盒中。
